Bug_Title: MS: May expose internal static state by creating a buffer which stores an external array into a static field (EI_EXPOSE_STATIC_BUF2)
Bug_Details:
This code creates a buffer which stores a reference to an external array or the array of an external buffer into
a static field.
 If unchecked changes to
 the array would compromise security or other
 important properties, you will need to do something different.
Storing a copy of the array is a better approach in many situations.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by storing a reference to an external array into a static field. This can lead to exposure of internal static state if the external array is modified after being stored.
Trigger_Explanation: The test triggers the bug by calling the showBug method with an external array. After setting the staticArray in StaticBufferExposure, the test modifies the original array. Since staticArray holds a reference to the original array, modifying the original array also affects staticArray, causing the test to fail.
